permit.applies: The employer (or an event organiser for a group) applies online through TTBizLink's Work Permit e-service and then submits the documents in person at the Ministry of National Security; groups of ten or more may use the group form.
permit.first: A job letter, the company's registration, a justification for employing a non-national and the contract details.

fees.what: Application for the grant of a Work Permit (from 1 January 2026)
For the duration of the Work Permit, per month, minimum TT$2,700

sources.title: Parliament of Trinidad and Tobago, Legal Notice No. 493 of 2025, The Immigration (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations, 2025
sources.said: These Regulations shall have effect from 1st January, 2026. … (ii) On application for the grant of Work Permit … 1200.00 (iii) For the duration of Work Permit 900.00 per month subject to a minimum of 2,700.00

sources.title: TTConnect (Government of Trinidad and Tobago), Work Permit
sources.said: If your visit is for 30 days or less within a 12-month period, you do not need a work permit. … Any non-national working in Trinidad and Tobago for more than 30 days. Individuals seeking an extension of a current work permit. Employers applying on behalf of foreign staff. … Group Work Permits (10 or more persons) Submit via editable PDF form or through the online system. Ideal for contractors, event organizers, and companies hiring multiple foreign workers. … Visit the Ministry of National Security with all required documentation. … These may include a valid passport, job letter, company registration, justification for employment, and contract details.

sources.title: Laws of Trinidad and Tobago, Immigration Act Chap. 18:01 and Immigration Regulations (L.R.O. 1/2009), copy on the Ministry of Trade and Industry's site
sources.said: Where an employer desires to employ a person who … falls outside of paragraphs (a), (b) and (c) of subregulation (1), … he shall apply in twelve copies to the Permanent Secretary in the … form set out as Form 3.
